0.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_ARDASHIR_000_000
0.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I was not expecting you to return so soon. Is...is something wrong?

1.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_Q1_000_000
1.description: Tell him you wish to abandon your work on the anima?

2.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_ARDASHIR_000_010
2.description: Of course, how silly of me! Though, for a moment, I was all but certain you wished to...to...

3.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_ARDASHIR_000_011
3.description: Ahem. But should the time come that you decide you can no longer continue, I would understand.

4.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_ARDASHIR_000_020
4.description: If it is rest you require, then it is rest you shall have. I should not have you overexert yourself for my sake. If and when you are willing to resume our research, I shall be here, ready and waiting.

5.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_ARDASHIR_000_030
5.description: Very well, then I shall contact Ulan and Arnott at once. If you want for respite, then our work will have to wait.

6.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_ARDASHIR_000_031
6.description: If and when you are willing to resume our research, I shall be here, ready and waiting.

7.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_SYSTEM_000_001
7.description: Should you choose to abandon the quest “A Dream Fulfilled,” the attributes of your anima weapon will be reset to their original values.

8.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_SYSTEM_000_002
8.description: Moreover, your progress will not be restored in the event you decide to undertake this quest again with the same job.

9.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_SYSTEM_000_003
9.description: Furthermore, any crystal sand or umbrite used during the course of this quest will be permanently lost.

10.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_SYSTEM_000_004
10.description: Please be advised that this process cannot be reversed.

11.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_Q1_000_010
11.description: Are you certain you wish to abandon the quest “A Dream Fulfilled” and reset your progress?

12.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_SYSTEM_000_010
12.description: You may speak with Ardashir at any time should you decide to abandon this quest in the future.

13.name: TEXT_JOBREL300QUESTLEAVE_00350_SYSTEM_000_020
13.description: You may speak with Ardashir at any time should you decide to undertake this quest in the future.
